# Public npm install fixture

The picocolors1.1.1 version, registry URL and SHA512 integrity are copied from
the existing WebSite/site-react/package-lock.json entry on September15,2026.
No hash was invented to satisfy admission. The explicit Linux command in
openspec/changes/workspace-node/EXECUTION-VERIFICATION.md verifies an actual
registry download and separate offline require/behavior check. Ordinary pytest
tests validate admission/staging without contacting the registry.

This one-package fixture proves the npm transport/install seam, not every npm
dependency shape or browser lifecycle. It is not a user workflow or a manifest
to install into either app-owned project.
